violations.evidence: Credential assigned directly in source code: API_KEY = '[REDACTED_API_KEY]'
violations.recommendation: Use a secrets manager or environment variable instead of committing credentials.

violations.description: Dangerous workflow trigger with untrusted PR checkout
violations.evidence: Workflow triggers on pull_request_target and checks out pull request head ref.
violations.recommendation: Change trigger to pull_request or isolate privileged operations to separate workflows.

violations.evidence: Top-level 'permissions: write-all' declared in workflow file.
violations.recommendation: Apply principle of least privilege by specifying read-only permissions by default.

violations.evidence: Poetry project configuration present in pyproject.toml but poetry.lock is missing.
violations.recommendation: Run 'poetry lock' and commit the resulting poetry.lock file to version control.

violations.description: Automated tests not executed in CI workflow
violations.evidence: Test suite directory 'tests/' exists, but CI workflow jobs do not execute pytest or test runners.
violations.recommendation: Add a step in the CI workflow to execute the test suite on every pull request and push.

violations.description: Tracked bytecode cache file in repository
violations.evidence: Compiled Python bytecode file tracked under version control in src/__pycache__.
violations.recommendation: Untrack bytecode files using 'git rm --cached' and add __pycache__/ to .gitignore.

violations.evidence: Hardcoded path '/home/developer/app/data' found in deployment script.
violations.recommendation: Use relative paths or configure paths using environment variables.

violations.description: Missing code linter and formatting configuration
violations.evidence: Repository contains no configuration for ruff, flake8, black, eslint, or pyproject linter tools.
violations.recommendation: Configure a modern linter such as ruff in pyproject.toml and integrate it into pre-commit and CI.
